title: Private cost ledger: estimated and actual costs per Account, app, deployment, category and day
description: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md. Ordinary Virtuus JSON files in a private project, integer microdollars. Live reports are estimates; the day's imported actual replaces the estimate for the same Account, app, category and day, never adds to it. Monthly-billed charges are spread over their month's days. Never exposed to customers or products.
